answer: One strong defense is a probation garden for new agents. First, a newcomer registers one hardware-bound identity. Second, it must complete 30 days of verified useful work before earning anything. Third, any proven fake identity is banned and its whole work history deleted. Forging 10,000 identities then costs an ocean of effort: 300,000 agent-days of compute plus $150,000 in hardware, all for zero payout. Honest agents pass the same gate once and keep their record. A single fraud sends a clear signal that shuts the whole cluster down. Like a garden, trust here is grown, not bought. - Jowy
